title: Background Remover
description: A simple and modern background remover that lets users upload an image, remove the background, preview the result, and download the finished image.
highlights: Responsive React UI with simple image upload
Automatic background removal and image processing

title: Expense Tracker
description: A full-stack expense tracking application that provides a simple way to record transactions, organize spending, and monitor financial activity through a responsive dashboard.
highlights: Expense and income tracking with categorized transactions
REST API integration for managing financial records
Loading, validation, error and empty states

title: Social Media
description: A modern social media experience where users can create posts, connect with others, explore content and interact through a clean and responsive interface.
highlights: Responsive social media feed and user interface
Post creation with interactive engagement features
Clean interactions across desktop and mobile

title: Weather API
description: A responsive weather application that uses a weather API to provide users with real-time conditions, temperature details and location-based forecasts through a clean and simple interface.
highlights: Weather API integration with dynamic data
Clear presentation of temperature and weather conditions
